title: 第9章 裴砚清第10章 师父要给她送男人
slug: 加入合欢宗后师妹的鱼塘炸了
content_zh:
第9章裴砚清箫声戛然而止，云洛灵台瞬间清明。
一睁眼，发现自己正挂在苏羡鱼身上，对方也搂着她的腰，两个人看起来不清不白。
二人如触电般松开彼此，苏羡鱼气急败坏。
“柳师姐，怎可随意使用魅术？”
“抱歉。”幻音夫人歉意一笑，“才拿回我的宝贝，没忍住。”
苏羡鱼抱手冷哼，原谅她了。
谁让对方是师父名下已经毕业五十年的弟子，她的亲亲师姐。
“炼器堂的祝长老说，这玉箫务必要好好保护，再坏一次可就彻底修不好了。”
她忍不住提醒，这玉箫是幻音夫人的本命法器，若是损毁，于她修为有碍。
“知道了，还是师妹关心我。”
幻音夫人收好玉箫，她施展魅术全靠它，自然不可怠慢。
魅术一般分为两个派别，一个是本体派，凭眼神和肢体就能施展魅术，需要极为强大的神识和天赋。
另一个是御物派，神识天赋比本体派弱，但可以依靠丹药、阵法、符箓或者器具弥补。
她便是靠曲律施展魅术，才有了幻音夫人这个雅称。
……
云洛两人在忘忧楼吃吃喝喝了快一个时辰，眼看着天色快黑了才准备离开。
幻音夫人亲自将二人送出店铺，没想到又遇见了那两位剑修。
或许是知道去而复返会落下乘，两人在门外徘徊，迟迟不肯踏入店内。
幻音夫人语气讥诮：
“二位道友，可是货比三家，最后发现还是我这便宜？”

俊秀少年尴尬低头，连他身旁被称作师兄的男人也不自在。
“先前是晚辈不懂事，冲撞了前辈，还请前辈恕罪。”
俊秀少年低头道歉，语气诚恳。
见他态度端正，幻音夫人没有太过为难他们。
“无妨，都是做生意，既然二位决定了，那便先给一千灵石的定金，三日后来取剑，再付剩下的灵石。”
俊秀少年抠抠搜搜从袋中掏出五百上品灵石，又怼了怼一旁的师兄。
“师兄……”
相貌平平的少年给了他一个乾坤袋。
“下个月还我。”
云洛本来都要走了，闻言停下脚步。
少年青衫猎猎，玉冠束发，身姿颀长若孤松立雪，翩然似谪仙，声音更是如山泉滴落玉石，清润悦耳。
可再看那张脸，平凡普通，怎么也无法与他身体的主人联系起来。
就像是一个超模身材的男人，转过身结果是宋大宝的脸，是个人都能看萎了。
哎，可能是丑人气质好吧。
苏羡鱼也注意到了，不过她的注意力很快被俊秀少年手中的剑所吸引。
作为器修，她看见高阶灵器就走不动路，看清后一脸痛心疾首：
“龙晶铁锻造的天品灵剑，为何不去合欢宗修复？”
幻音夫人在炼器上颇有成就，但以目前修为想要修复天品也是勉强。
content_en:
Chapter 9 The sound of Pei Yan playing the flute suddenly stopped, and the Yunluo Lingtai suddenly became clear.
When she opened her eyes, she found that she was hanging on Su Xianyu, who was also holding her waist. The two of them looked unclear.
The two let go of each other like an electric shock, and Su Xianyu was furious.
"Senior Sister Liu, how can you use charm at will?"
"Sorry." Mrs. Phantom Sound apologized, "I just got my baby back, I couldn't hold it back."
Su Xianyu folded her hands and snorted, forgiving her.
Who knows that the other party is the master's disciple who has graduated for fifty years, her senior sister.
"Elder Zhu from the Artifact Refining Hall said that this jade flute must be well protected. If it breaks again, it will be completely unrepairable."
She couldn't help but remind her that this jade flute was Mrs. Huanyin's natal magical weapon. If it was damaged, it would hinder her cultivation.
"I know, junior sister still cares about me."
Mrs. Huan Yin put away the jade flute. She relied on it to cast her charm, so she couldn't neglect it.
Charm arts are generally divided into two factions. One is the noumenal sect. Charm arts can be performed with eyes and body, which requires extremely powerful spiritual consciousness and talent.
The other is the Monomonist sect, whose spiritual talent is weaker than that of the Noumenon sect, but they can make up for it by relying on elixirs, formations, talismans or equipment.
She relied on the rhythm of music to cast her charm, so she got the nickname Mrs. Phantom Sound.
…
Yunluo and the others ate and drank in Wangyou Tower for almost an hour, and saw that it was getting dark before they prepared to leave.
Mrs. Huanyin personally sent the two of them out of the shop, but unexpectedly she met the two sword cultivators again.
Perhaps because they knew they would miss out if they returned, the two of them lingered outside the door, reluctant to step into the store.
Mrs. Phantom Sound’s tone was sarcastic:
"Two fellow Taoists, after shopping around, you finally found out that I was the cheaper one?"
The handsome young man lowered his head in embarrassment, and even the man next to him who was called senior brother felt uncomfortable.
"It was the junior who was ignorant and bumped into the senior. Please forgive me."
The handsome young man bowed his head and apologized with a sincere tone.
Seeing that he had a correct attitude, Mrs. Huanyin did not embarrass them too much.
"It doesn't matter, it's all business. Now that you two have decided, let's pay a deposit of one thousand spirit stones first, pick up the sword after three days, and then pay the remaining spirit stones."
The handsome young man took out 500 high-grade spiritual stones from his bag, and then scolded the senior brother beside him.
"Senior brother..."
The ordinary-looking young man gave him a Qiankun bag.
"Pay me back next month."
Yunluo was about to leave, but stopped when he heard this.
The young man hunts in a green shirt, with his hair tied up in a jade crown. His figure is as tall and tall as a lone pine tree standing in the snow, and he is as graceful as an immortal. His voice is like jade dripping from a mountain spring, clear and sweet.
But looking at that face again, it was ordinary and ordinary, and there was no way to connect it with the owner of his body.
It was like a man with a supermodel figure. When he turned around, he saw Song Dabao's face, which made anyone look pale.
Hey, maybe it’s because of the ugly temperament.
Su Xianyu also noticed, but her attention was quickly attracted by the sword in the hand of the handsome young man.
As a weapon cultivator, she couldn't walk when she saw high-level spiritual weapons. After seeing them clearly, she looked distressed:
"Why don't you go to the Hehuan Sect to repair the heaven-grade spiritual sword forged from dragon crystal iron?"
Mrs. Huanyin is quite accomplished in refining weapons, but with her current level of cultivation, it is still difficult to repair a heavenly product.
